title: OpenXR Spatial Container integration
body: This introduces support for `XR_EXT_spatial_container` & `XR_EXT_spatial_container_self_rendering`, newly ratified OpenXR multi-vendor (EXT) extensions, that defines the new **OpenXR Multi-App paradigm**. In this new paradigm, OpenXR introduces **Spatial Containers**, an abstraction for an OpenXR application to render into a shared scene via a bounded or unbounded volume in space, allowing OpenXR applications to multi-task alongside other spatial container and / or regular applications. For more info about OpenXR Multi-App, please take a look at the SIGGRAPH 2026 [talk](https://youtu.be/V68nO3Vxok8?t=3078&si=HIVgYeXJhv8qBtTk) and [slides](https://www.khronos.org/assets/uploads/developers/presentations/OpenXR_BOF_v2_SIGG_2026_-_Slides.pdf): **Note:** Keeping in draft until https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123123 is merged.

+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
+<class name="OpenXRSpatialContainerExtension" inherits="OpenXRExtensionWrapper" api_type="core" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../../../doc/class.xsd">
+	<brief_description>
+		OpenXR extension that handles spatial containers.
+	</brief_description>
+	<description>
+		OpenXR extension that handles spatial containers. Enabling this extension will automatically create a main spatial container, and update the lifecycle of the XR application.
+	</description>
+	<tutorials>
+	</tutorials>
+	<methods>
+		<method name="get_spatial_container_bounds">
+			<return type="Vector3" />
+			<description>
+				Retrieves the bounds of the main spatial container.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+		<method name="get_spatial_container_state">
+			<return type="OpenXRSpatialContainerState" />
+			<description>
+				Retrieves the [OpenXRSpatialContainerState] of the main spatial container.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+		<method name="get_supported_bounds_modes">
+			<return type="Array" />
+			<description>
+				Returns an array of supported spatial container bounds mode, see [enum OpenXRSpatialContainerState.BoundsMode].
+			</description>
+		</method>
+		<method name="is_enabled" qualifiers="const">
+			<return type="bool" />
+			<description>
+				Returns [code]true[/code] if spatial containers are enabled in the project settings and available on the current runtime.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+		<method name="is_spatial_container_active" qualifiers="const">
+			<return type="bool" />
+			<description>
+				Returns [code]true[/code] if the main spatial container is active.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+		<method name="request_spatial_container_bounds_mode">
+			<return type="bool" />
+			<param index="0" name="bounds_mode" type="int" enum="OpenXRSpatialContainerState.BoundsMode" />
+			<description>
+				Sends a request to the runtime to update the bounds mode of the main spatial container.
+				If the request is accepted, [signal spatial_container_bounds_changed] will be emitted with the updated bounds mode.
+				Otherwise, [signal spatial_container_bounds_mode_request_denied] will be emitted.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+		<method name="request_spatial_container_visible">
+			<return type="bool" />
+			<param index="0" name="visible" type="bool" />
+			<description>
+				Sends a request to the runtime to update the visibility of the spatial container.
+				If the request is accepted, [signal spatial_container_visible_changed] will be emitted with the updated visibility.
+				Otherwise, [signal spatial_container_visible_request_denied] will be emitted.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+	</methods>
+	<signals>
+		<signal name="spatial_container_bounds_changed">
+			<param index="0" name="spatial_container_rid" type="RID" />
+			<param index="1" name="spatial_container_infinite_bounds" type="bool" />
+			<param index="2" name="spatial_container_bounds_mode" type="int" />
+			<param index="3" name="spatial_container_bounds" type="Vector3" />
+			<description>
+				Emitted when the bounds of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] are updated.
+			</description>
+		</signal>
+		<signal name="spatial_container_bounds_mode_request_denied">
+			<param index="0" name="spatial_container_rid" type="RID" />
+			<description>
+				Emitted when a request to update the bounds mode of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] is denied by the runtime.
+			</description>
+		</signal>
+		<signal name="spatial_container_closed">
+			<param index="0" name="spatial_container_rid" type="RID" />
+			<description>
+				Emitted when the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] is closed.
+			</description>
+		</signal>
+		<signal name="spatial_container_interactable_changed">
+			<param index="0" name="spatial_container_rid" type="RID" />
+			<param index="1" name="spatial_container_interactable" type="bool" />
+			<description>
+				Emitted when the interactability of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] is updated.
+			</description>
+		</signal>
+		<signal name="spatial_container_visible_changed">
+			<param index="0" name="spatial_container_rid" type="RID" />
+			<param index="1" name="spatial_container_visible" type="bool" />
+			<description>
+				Emitted when the visibility of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid] is updated.
+			</description>
+		</signal>
+		<signal name="spatial_container_visible_request_denied">
+			<param index="0" name="spatial_container_rid" type="RID" />
+			<description>
+				Emitted when the runtime denies the visibility request of the spatial container specified by [param spatial_container_rid].
+			</description>
+		</signal>
+	</signals>
+</class>

+<class name="OpenXRSpatialContainerSelfRenderingExtension" inherits="OpenXRExtensionWrapper" api_type="core" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../../../doc/class.xsd">
+	<brief_description>
+		OpenXR extension that defines "self rendering" for spatial containers.

+	<description>
+		OpenXR extension that defines "self rendering" for spatial containers. A self rendered spatial container's pixels are all generated by an app and submitted to the runtime using standard OpenXR swapchains and composition layers.

+			</description>

+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
+<class name="OpenXRSpatialContainerState" inherits="RefCounted" api_type="core" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../../../doc/class.xsd">
+	<brief_description>
+		An object representing the state of an OpenXR spatial container.
+	</brief_description>
+	<description>
+		The [OpenXRSpatialContainerState] object holds information about the current state of a spatial container, including its visibility, interactability, and bounds mode.
+	</description>
+	<tutorials>
+	</tutorials>
+	<methods>
+		<method name="get_bounds_mode" qualifiers="const">
+			<return type="int" enum="OpenXRSpatialContainerState.BoundsMode" />
+			<description>
+				Returns the current bounds mode of the spatial container.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+		<method name="is_interactable" qualifiers="const">
+			<return type="bool" />
+			<description>
+				Returns the current interactability of the spatial container.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+		<method name="is_visible" qualifiers="const">
+			<return type="bool" />
+			<description>
+				Returns the current visibility state of the spatial container.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+	</methods>
+	<constants>
+		<constant name="BOUNDS_MODE_BOUNDED" value="0" enum="BoundsMode">
+			The spatial container is in bounded mode.
+		</constant>
+		<constant name="BOUNDS_MODE_IMMERSIVE" value="1" enum="BoundsMode">
+			The spatial container is in immersive mode.
+		</constant>
+	</constants>
+</class>

+#pragma once
+
+#include "core/object/ref_counted.h"
+#include "core/variant/binder_common.h"
+
+#include <openxr/openxr.h>
+
+class OpenXRSpatialContainerState : public RefCounted {
+	GDCLASS(OpenXRSpatialContainerState, RefCounted);
+
+public:
+	enum BoundsMode {
+		BOUNDS_MODE_BOUNDED,
+		BOUNDS_MODE_IMMERSIVE,
+	};
+
+	BoundsMode get_bounds_mode() const;
+	bool is_interactable() const;
+	bool is_visible() const;
+
+	OpenXRSpatialContainerState() {}
+	OpenXRSpatialContainerState(const XrSpatialContainerStateEXT &p_state);
+
+protected:
+	static void _bind_methods();
+
+private:
+	friend class OpenXRSpatialContainerExtension;
+
+	static XrSpatialContainerBoundsModeEXT _from_bounds_mode(BoundsMode p_mode);
+	static BoundsMode _to_bounds_mode(XrSpatialContainerBoundsModeEXT p_mode);
+
+	BoundsMode bounds_mode = BOUNDS_MODE_BOUNDED;
+	bool interactable = false;
+	bool visible = false;
+};
+
+VARIANT_ENUM_CAST(OpenXRSpatialContainerState::BoundsMode);
